reviews.text: Paola is a competent, empathetic and super-scrupulous veterinarian, I consider myself lucky to have found La Tortuga

Dr. Paola and Francesca are exceptional, professional, empathetic, and very friendly. We visited their veterinary practice for our puppy and were immediately impressed by their approach to both us and our little Tyson. Our experience was super positive; we found the right place and we won't leave.
Always exhausted, never has time. Not at all empathetic. A truly awful experience.

You cannot find a more caring, knowledgeable, and amazing veterinarian! They go above and beyond!
Sono perfette!

I went to Dr. Paola for my cockatiel's first visit, and I relied heavily on the many great reviews I'd read. I can only confirm everything else that others have said... the doctor is incredibly professional and compassionate. I really appreciated the way she treated my little guy and me too. I thank both her and Francesca, two wonderful people whose passion for animals is immediately apparent.
